Please add gen AI labels. It's just slop, and they are stealing from actual devs and creatives. I like and dislike system is just going to be used the exact same way if you are concerned about harassment. Either way, people will make their own filtering system if you don’t. 

Also, this game is not appropriate for children; it should be 18+, and everyone should have to go through the age verification process. In public servers, whenever there are kids, adults talk to them about porn, other highly disturbing stuff, and bully them. 18+ SFW group instances are safe for adults and really chill, but there is nothing like that for minors that actually protects them. In some cases, children are targeting adults (especially ones who are older, male, and/or furry) who are just minding their business, and they keep being extremely sexually inappropriate and putting themselves in harm's way to try and “catch predators”. 

Part of the responsibility is the parents, but it's also your apathy that is allowing these toxic environments to exist. If you want children there, which is kind of weird, please put in advanced parental controls and more advanced filtering of UGC, such as avatars, because those are not filtered out. 

I don't feel like VRChat is really putting in the effort to enforce these, so I'm reporting to the IC3 and/or NCMEC cyber-tipline.
title: Generative AI Labels & Age Appropriate Content
